scope: Compact export of recorded measurements; detailed arrays removed, not a new experiment.

protocol.scope:
Auxiliary-source coverage pilot: fixed classifiers, matched source ablations.
CSE flows must precede 27 Feb2018; March1 reference capture remains excluded.
One fixed fit per condition/seed; two-source references reuse stage0 fits.
protocol.control: Full/restricted CSE cases share exact ToN, UNSW and 25000 CSE benign rows. Only the 25000 CSE attack-source rows differ; source-family capture/time confounding remains possible.
protocol.model_capacity: 100 trees,15 leaves,min_child100,lambda10; same stage0 seed as two-source references
